violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ONSITE HAS AN EXPIRED CERTIFICATION (EXPIRED IN JULY OF 2025).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE OBTAIN A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION BY THE 22ND OF FEBRUARY. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THAT A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATION HAS BEEN OBTAINED.
